additional_info.subject: RE: ID0391608-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312561850/27] Preauthorization error CRM:00641000780
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well,
The issue was opened for clarification of the error "
preauthorize status error. Error message: Terminal candidate list empty".
Kindly refer the below steps to troubleshoot the error.
Check, if right ports are used to connect COR A10 to OPM-C60.
Check cable connection between Processing Unit and Card Reader.
Re-connect cables and re-start charger.
Exchange COR A10.
And please carry the spare of COR A10 in case of replacement is needed
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
